# DataThinker — Xia He-Bleinagel

> Personal site of Xia He-Bleinagel, Head of Data and Cloud. Speaking, training, mentoring, and writing on data leadership, cloud strategy, and career growth in tech.

Site: https://www.datathinker.de
Preferred language for blog content: English (also mirrored under German URL paths)
Default UI locale: German (`/`), English under `/en/`
